scope: Bounded read-only sanity check of three private retrospective metadata helpers; no whole review rerun, source edits, SSH, or model/tool work

checked.supplemental_json_type_preservation: Required strings compare exactly; sensor integer uses exact type int so bool cannot pass. Service map requires exact service set and each method/path; extra nested fields do not remove required checks.
checked.frozen_grade_preservation: Original strict/oracle fields copied as frozen; supplemental output_contract_passed separate. write_new appends new receipts and never rewrites result files/candidates.
checked.file_safety: JSON-only candidate reads: final component nofollow/nonblocking, regularowned single-link,65536-byte cap, postread inode/size/mtime consistency. Candidate export parent directories are trusted private operator directories outside worker mounts.
checked.thought_export_boundary: Gateway audit considers only function_call/function_call_output records. Raw commands limited to explicitly permitted private executed-tool export; public supplemental receipt contains hashes and semanticfacts only. No reasoning or message fields exported.
checked.lifecycle_identity: Final verifier uses trial_binding for original full DockerIDs, allocationlabels and StartedAt, verifies stopped/nonrestarting originalroles and boundvolume metadata, originalreservations completed or durablyfenced, priorstates/servicebinding/volumes and signedinputs.
checked.no_cleanup_or_resume: Helpers only observe sources and append new metadata receipts. No container start,stop,delete, model dispatch, attempt reset or retry.

limits: Retrospective helper source validation; actual final lifecycle verification receipts still require operator execution.
Host-owned private receipt paths and original export parent directories are trusted; worker-controlled contents are parsed as bounded data.
Supplemental diagnostics and required-field checks do not replace frozen primary grades or establish broader promotion.
